name: sibling-single-photo-kit
about: The second picture where the kit has one photo: the same photo, another hour and another viewpoint, not a rewording.

recipe.name: Fixture concept
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our tractor on an open highway at {time_of_day}, {light}, photographed from {viewpoint}, no text, no logos, no lettering

equipment_photos.label: white tractor, front three-quarter view, parked at the yard

slots.time_of_day: golden hour on a late-summer evening
slots.light: low warm sun raking across the cab, long shadows on the pavement, glowing sky
slots.viewpoint: a low angle near the road surface, ahead of the cab and to one side, looking up

slots.time_of_day: first light on a cool October morning between harvested cornfields
slots.light: sun just above the horizon behind the cab, rim light on the hood, thin ground mist, pink sky
slots.viewpoint: a low angle from the opposite shoulder, beside the front bumper, looking up
